changePlan.action: Use at most two ordinary transfers only for confirmed loss of role or injury.
Re-run advancement simulation; move one or two slots from teams drifting below 24th to top-16 probabilities.
Protect flexibility and retain cash/value; eliminated-player replacements do not consume the ordinary limit once removed from the game list.
For direct-R16 players compare the guaranteed 6/5 office vote with a temporary equal-or-cheaper starter; avoid a temporary goalkeeper unless the replacement exceeds the 5-point office baseline.
Concentrate transfers on confirmed starters from teams with the highest conditional reach-QF/SF probability; never spend both ordinary changes before lineups and availability are refreshed.
